subject: Nebula Health POC: proposed checkpoints, owners, and kickoff availability
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@nebulahealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Nebula Health POC: proposed checkpoints, owners, and kickoff availability

Hi Asha / Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed timeline so we can lock in dates and owners. Please flag anything missing.

Call highlights
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for Nebula Health triage assistance workflows (structured prompts, privacy controls).
- Primary success criteria (we should agree on these explicitly):
  * Relevance: +10% top-1 accuracy on the curated triage test-set vs baseline (Nebula test suite)
  * Latency: 95th percentile inference latency <= 200ms for 512-token requests under production-like batching
  * Cost guardrail: unit cost per 1k tokens within agreed threshold (we can fine-tune after a sample run)
  * Security: no PHI persistence beyond ephemeral caches; KMS key usage for customer-provided secrets

Proposed POC timeline (flexible)
- Week 0 (kickoff): environment setup, API keys, data schema review, access provisioning
- Week 1: data ingest & integration demo (sample data, mapping, small-scale run)
- Weeks 2–3: baseline collection & metric gathering (relevance + latency under representative load)
- Week 4: remediation + tuning (quantization / batching / caching adjustments)
- Final readout: 30–45 minute session with stakeholders to review metrics, logs, and next steps

Initial suggested dates (please confirm):
- Kickoff: week of Jun 22 — proposed day: Tue, Jun 23 (we can adjust)
- Weekly check-ins: Thursdays, 11:00 AM PT (30 min)
- Final readout: week of Jul 20 (flexible based on baseline window)

Ownership (Redwood / Nebula)
- POC lead (Redwood): Mina Haddad — overall coordination, success criteria owner
- Integration & infra (Redwood): Marcus Lin — VPC/service account, ingestion, runbook
- Evaluation & metrics (Redwood): Jasmine Liu — eval harness, metric collection, prompts/test sets
- Nebula contacts: Asha (product lead), Tom (engineering), Lydia (procurement)

Immediate next steps
1) Please confirm kickoff date (Jun 23 works for you?) and weekly check-in cadence.
2) Share a sample of the triage dataset (anonymized) or a small synthetic sample by EOD next Tue so Marcus can validate ingestion.
3) I'll attach a short scope doc and runbook stub after this email (see attachments).

Attachments: [attachment: nebula_poc_scope.pdf (PDF)], [attachment: redwood_poc_runbook.xlsx (XLSX)]

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0129

Subject: Re: Nebula Health POC: proposed checkpoints, owners, and kickoff availability

Mina — thanks for the clear summary. This looks good overall. A few quick items from our side:

- Timeline: Jun 23 works better for the product team (Jun 22 is tight). Can we make kickoff Tue, Jun 23 at 10:00 AM PT?
- Weekly cadence: prefer Thursdays at 12:00 PM PT if that keeps our engineering folks available.
- Procurement / security: looping Lydia — we will need:
  * SOC 2 report + attestation
  * Data handling statement specifically called out for PHI (even if anonymized)
  * A short DPIA or confirmation that redwood will not persist PHI beyond ephemeral caches
- Access: we'll create a service account with scoped read-only S3 access for a sample dataset; Marcus / Mina please share the required IAM roles.

I'll get a procurement contact (Lydia) to start the paperwork. Also copying Tom for technical intake.

On dataset delivery: we'll aim to provide an anonymized sample by Jun 18. If you need synthetic earlier, let us know.

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Best,
Asha
Head of Product, Nebula Health
asha.patel@nebulahealth.com | (415) 222-9800

Adding a quick technical checklist for kickoff. I'll be the primary integration owner during the kickoff week — ping me on Slack or on-call if anything blocks.

Pre-kickoff checklist (Marcus)
- Provide required IAM roles: redwood-poc-ingest-readonly, redwood-poc-metrics-writer
- S3 sample path: s3://nebula-sandbox/poc-samples/ (Nebula to confirm)
- Networking: if you prefer private connectivity we can do VPC peering (security review required) — otherwise a scoped service account + restricted IP allowlist will work
- Test accounts: please create one service account for Redwood with minimal privileges; share key rotation windows if you have a policy
- Logs/observability: we will provide a shared CloudWatch/Stackdriver read-only view for metric correlation (let us know preferred provider)

Attachments referenced: redwood_poc_runbook.xlsx (contains onboarding steps and validation checklist)
JIRA: INF-4521 created for kickoff infra tasks

I'll also come prepared with a quick sanity-run checklist to validate end-to-end inference (sample -> model -> metrics).
